cutoff_sweep.note: the m=2 tail sweep follows the plan literally; at m=2 the ForwardProducts contrast is not yet visible (forward error 1.9e-3, 1.3e-3, 1.3e-3), so the method contrast is recorded at m=4 where it is. C = 16 and 20 extend the plan's C <= 12 range to windows that cover the seed many times over; C = 22 ... 44 extend it further to measure the tail's slow decay and to test whether the rank-4 inside-window error ever leaves its plateau. Every C >= 16 cell solves to 1e-10 relative residual with a 1024-step cap because the smallest scheduled shift stalls just above 1e-13 there

energy_convention: H = dGamma(h) with h = 1/2 p^2 + 1/2 k^2 phi^2 + lambda/4 (phi^2 - v^2)^2; the lambda v^4/4 constant is retained and lifts to c N_out; products are formed inside h before dGamma
limitations: the full-action charge is the amplitude-overlap bound (2 a + a^2 on <psi|e>), not the state bound: the state bound was tightened from 5.95 to 0.18 and its charge 0.39 -> 0.00076 (base), an ~500x improvement, which is what lets the defect route certify the 5.6e-2 momentum-spread response (charge 1.27e-2) but not the 1.6e-3 coupling response (charge 1.79e-3, a factor 1.1 short). The sharp tier (measured compressed-flow discrepancy against the exact seed-column evolution of the declared window) certifies both
the rank-2 cell on the degree-2 window reports the windowed return probability, which is 8.65e-4 below the converged window value because the omitted tail (squared norm 9/2) is projected out
the ForwardProducts diagnostic is more accurate than shift-invert at m = 4 on these bounded windows; the plan's degradation claim appears only as growth with C, not as a rank-for-rank deficit
momenta are continuous; no lattice or momentum sum is used anywhere in this record

exact.note: must be zero: the transported tuple is unitarily equivalent to the base tuple

change_of_basis_control.operator_matrix_difference_kind: Frobenius norm of P H' P - P H P on the declared window
change_of_basis_control.seed: one field quantum He_1(phi), phi-parity-1 window; theta_phi = 0 leaves it bit-identical, so the transport acts on the momentum basis

sirk.note: the two arms are different matrices and different Krylov bases, so each carries its own compressive defect; the exact arm is the zero-response statement

change_of_basis_control.transport: U = exp(i sum_m theta_m n_m): q_m -> cos(theta_m) q_m + 2 sin(theta_m) p_m, p_m -> cos(theta_m) p_m - sin(theta_m) q_m / 2; h -> U h U^dagger, seed -> U seed
